a: ऋश् — (A Sautra root) 1 To go. --2 To kill.

v: hiMsAyAM gatO ca sO॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । arSati ArSIt AnarSa AnuSatuH arSaH । fSyaH ।
m: ऋश m. the male of a species of antelope = the next, AV. iv, 4, 7.
ऋश्याङ्क m. N. of A-niruddha, L.

v: pu॰ pARinyukte caturarTyAM kapratyayanimitte SabdagaResa ca gaRaH । “fSya, nyagroDa, Sara, nilIna, nivAsa, nivAta, niDAna, nibanDa, vibadDa, parigUQa, upagUQa, aSani, sita, mata veSman, uttarASman, aSman, sTUla, bAhu, Kadira, SarkarA, anaquh, araqu, parivaMSa, beRu, vIraRa, KaRqa, daRqa, parivftta, kardama, aMSu” ।
m: ऋश्यादि m. N. of a gaṇa, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80.

s: puM, strI, (fS + kyap .) mfgaviSezaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, fgvede । 8 । 4 । 10 । “fSyo na tfzyannavapAnamAgahi” ॥)
v: tri॰ fSa--karmaRi kyap । 1 hiMsye 3 mfge puMstrI SabdaratnA॰ । striyAM jAtitve'pi yopaDatvAt wAp । “fSyo na tfzyannavapAnamA gahi” f॰ 8, 4, 10, “fSya fSyAKyomfga iva tfzyan BA॰ “vasuBya fSyAnAlaBeta” yaju॰ 24, 27, “fSyo mayUraH suparRRaste ganDarvARAm” yaju॰ 34, 27, tataH caturarTyAm fSyA॰ ka । FSyaka tatsannikfzwadeSAdO । BAve kyap । 3 hiMsAyAM na॰ । fSyaM hiMsAM patanena dadAti dA--ka । fSyada kUpe pu॰ “yuvaM bandanamfSyadAdudUpaTuH” f॰ 10, 39, 8 । “fSyadAt kUpAt” BA॰ ।
m: ऋश्य or (in later texts) ऋष्य, अस्, m. the male of a species of antelope, the painted or white-footed antelope, RV. viii, 4, 10; AV. v, 14, 3; VS.; AitBr.; Suśr. &c.; N. of a Ṛṣi, ĀrṣBr.; of a son of Devātithi, BhP.; (अम्), n. hurt, violation, T. (for the explanation of ऋश्य-द); [cf. रिश्य.]
a: ऋश्य — a. [ऋश्-कर्मणि-क्यप्] To be killed. --श्यः A white-footed antelope. --श्यं Killing. --Comp. --केतुः, --केतनः {1} N. of Aniruddha, son of Pradyumna. {2} N. of the god of love. --दः a pit for catching antelopes. --पद् a. having the feet of an antelope.

m: ऋश्य—शृङ्ग m. N. of several men.
ऋश्य—द n. a pit (for catching antelopes, BRD.; as hurting what falls into it, T.)
ऋश्य—गन्धा f. a species of plant, Car.
ऋश्य—जिह्व n. a kind of leprosy, Car.; Suśr.
ऋश्यक mfn. ifc. having the colour of or looking like the white-footed antelope, R.
ऋश्य—केतन and ऋश्य—केतु, m. N. of A-niruddha, L.
ऋश्य—लोभ m. N. of a man.
ऋश्य—मूक m. N. of a mountain, VP.; R.; Pañcat. &c.

v: tri॰ fSyasyeva pAdAvasya antyalopaH samA॰ । mfgasadfSapAdayukte striyAM NIz padBAvaSca । “fSyapadIM vfzaMdatIM gozeDAM viDamAmyuta” aTa॰ 1, 184 ।

m: ऋश्य—प्रोक्ता f. N. of several plants.
